title: Archive-integrity verifier for the checkpoint skill

slices.description: checkpoint-archive-check.sh verifier + its test group in run.sh.
steps: Script exists at skills/checkpoint/scripts/checkpoint-archive-check.sh, bash 3.2-safe, zero deps, optional [root] arg defaulting to git toplevel.

Probe: a fixture git repo with a dirty tracked file under .harness-mini/docs/exec-plans/ makes the script exit 1 and name the file; a completed plan with stage != done, twin status != done, or a passes:false slice exits 1 naming plan+field; a clean consistent fixture exits 0 silently; missing active/ or completed/ dirs are skipped.
New @group checkpoint-archive-check in tests/run.sh covers those cases; bash tests/run.sh checkpoint-archive-check green with count matching --list; full suite green with updated --list totals.
skills/checkpoint/SKILL.md archival step mandates checkpoint-archive-check (exit 1 => fix first, no checkpoint written).
skills/stage-viewer/SKILL.md done-advance condition references the check passing.
skills/release/SKILL.md pre-flight notes the clean-tree gate counts untracked files (move session scratch out first).
